description: A utility module providing path-based navigation and manipulation utilities for nested dictionaries, including get, delete, and path parsing functions. Supports dot notation and JSONPath-like array syntax for accessing and modifying nested data structures.

methods.name: Optional[T] get_nested_value( data: Dict[str, Any], key_path: str, default: Optional[T] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested dictionary using a dot notation path, with optional default if path not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] delete_nested_value( data: Dict[str, Any], path: str, depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = 20, )
methods.description: Deletes a nested field from a dictionary using a JSONPath-like syntax, returning a modified copy.

methods.name: list _parse_path_segments(path: str)
methods.description: Parses a JSONPath-like string into path segments, handling fields and array notation.

methods.name: None _delete_nested_value_custom( data: Union[Dict[str, Any], List[Any]], segments: list, segment_index: int = 0, )
methods.description: Recursive helper to delete nested data based on parsed path segments, modifying data in-place.

methods.name: bool is_nested_path(path: str)
methods.description: Checks if a path string indicates a nested or array path.
